Team —

Thanks again to everyone for closing WP-4589 (WellPath Health). Contract signed and first invoice scheduled for 2027-08-01. This thread is the official sales->CS handoff: please see the high-level context and immediate asks below. I will loop back for one-week check-ins then drop to monthly exec sync once activation is stable.

Quick context:
- Product: Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool, private VPC).
- Commitment: 8x A100-equivalent GPUs, 24/7 baseline, burst to 12 for up to 2 hours/day.
- Primary use: internal clinical summarization pipelines (batched documents + realtime triage).
- SLA target: 95th pct latency < 350ms for realtime calls (90 tokens).
- Go-live target: 2027-09-15 (production traffic), pilot with 1 team by 2027-08-22.
- Security: customer requires SOC 2 evidence, network egress controls, and KMS integration. See attached signed SOW and SOC2 redacted PDF.

Key expectations / open items (action owners in parentheses):
1) Project owner from CS: assign primary and secondary (Marissa primary, Sergio secondary) — owner should lead kickoffs, weekly STA, and runbook approvals. (vivek)
2) Network preflight: customer will complete network_preflight_checklist.xlsx; networking run scheduled 7/20. (Aditya to own coordination)
3) Model pinning & migration plan: customer will bring two fine-tuned models + one baseline open model. Need validation tests and a canary rollout plan. (Aditya + Jordan)
4) Security/data flow: KMS integration & audit log retention policy to be confirmed; procurement has vendor questions on data residency. (Marissa + Security)
5) Billing & milestone ops: first invoice 8/1; need invoice contact and PO from procurement. (Finance cc'ed)

Attachments included: WellPath_WP-4589_SOW_signed.pdf, network_preflight_checklist.xlsx, SOC2-redacted.pdf

Immediate asks this week (by 7/16):
- Marissa: confirm primary owner and availability for a 60-min kickoff (prefer 7/19 or 7/20).
- Aditya: prepare initial network/runbook draft and answer whether the customer's existing TF-serving pipeline can be imported into the dedicated pool.
- Sergio: draft success metrics for 30/60/90 day checkpoints and initial training plan for customer ops.

Olivia / Marcus — feel free to add anything I missed. Marissa will follow up with the kickoff invite once owners are confirmed.

Thanks,
Vivek

Marissa / team —

Quick technical notes to seed the runbook and the network checklist:
- Network: We'll need three egress ranges opened for the dedicated control plane, plus port 443 outbound to our registry. I've attached a minimal diagram in the Jira (RED-8812). NAT + proxy allowed.
- TF-serving import: The customer's TF-serving models can be imported but we'll need saved models in TF SavedModel or ONNX. If they're using a custom op, we should plan for a build/test phase in staging.
- Canary plan suggestion: start with 5% traffic for 24 hours with increased telemetry, then 25% for 48 hours, then full cutover after validation. We'll automate rollback on error budget breach.
- Test harness: I can provide a lightweight test harness that runs their evaluation dataset and emits latency/cost reports — will upload to the Drive link by EOD 7/13.

Attachments referenced: network_preflight_checklist.xlsx (filled draft), runbook-stub.md

—Aditya
